description: This file defines the AppMeshClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, which provides methods to interact with the AWS App Mesh service, including creating, deleting, describing, listing, and updating mesh, route, and virtual node/router resources.

classes.name: AppMeshClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS App Mesh service, extending the generic AwsClient and providing specific methods for App Mesh operations.

methods.name: createMesh
methods.description: Creates a new App Mesh mesh with specified parameters.

methods.name: createMeshAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new App Mesh mesh.

methods.name: createRoute
methods.description: Creates a new route within a virtual router.

methods.name: createRouteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new route within a virtual router.

methods.name: createVirtualNodeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new virtual node.

methods.name: createVirtualRouterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new virtual router.

methods.name: describeMeshAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a mesh.

methods.name: describeVirtualNode
methods.description: Provides details about a virtual node.

methods.name: describeVirtualNodeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously provides details about a virtual node.

methods.name: describeVirtualRouter
methods.description: Provides details about a virtual router.

methods.name: describeVirtualRouterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously provides details about a virtual router.
